app.name: Zankup
app.claim: Your sports data, from start to finish.
signIn.title: Sign in
feed.title: Activities
feed.empty: No activities yet. They appear here after the first Garmin sync.
activity.notFound: This activity does not exist or is not yours.
notFound.title: Page not found
signIn.panel: Your private Zankup instance. Sync with Garmin, import your Strava history and follow your form without depending on anyone.
signIn.codeSub: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
signIn.error.noTotp: Two-step verification is not set up for this account yet. Set it up with python -m zankup.admin enable-totp.
signIn.error.tooMany: Too many attempts. Try again in {seconds} s.
signIn.error.expired: That took too long. Enter your password again.
signIn.error.passkey: That passkey could not be used.
signIn.error.network: The server could not be reached. Check your connection.
setup.title: Create your account
setup.sub: This instance has no account yet. It will be yours alone.
setup.codeHelp: It is in the server logs (Railway → Deployments → Logs): "Sign-up is open… setup code: XXXX-XXXX-XXXX".
setup.name: Your name
setup.passwordHelp: At least 12 characters. Checked against known data breaches without sending it.
setup.accept: I understand that my data stays on this instance, which only I run, and that Zankup has no central service.
setup.totpSub: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, 1Password, Aegis…), then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
setup.totpKey: Can't scan it? Enter this key
setup.recoverySub: If you lose your phone, each of these codes replaces the 6-digit code once. Keep them somewhere safe: they will not be shown again.
setup.saved: I have saved my recovery codes
setup.doneSub: Your account is ready and you are signed in.
setup.next.garmin: Activities from Garmin arrive every 15 minutes; your full history can be loaded too.
setup.next.strava: Strava history and themes come next.
setup.closedSub: This instance already has its account.
setup.error.code: That setup code is not right. Copy it again from the server logs.
setup.error.name: Enter your name.
setup.error.accept: Accept how your data is handled to continue.
setup.error.short: The password must have at least 12 characters.
setup.error.expired: That took too long. Start again with the setup code.
feed.pick: Pick an activity to see its details.
profile.title: Profile
settings.themeHelp: Saved in your account: it follows you to other browsers and the app.
activity.hint: Hover the chart or the route. Drag across the chart to pick a section.
activity.zonesNote: Zones from {low} % to {high} % of your max HR ({hrMax} bpm).
activity.zonesEstimate: Until you set your max HR in Settings, the highest you have recorded is used ({hrMax} bpm).
activity.zonesNone: Set your max HR in Settings to see your zones.
activity.mapFallback: The map needs WebGL, which this browser does not have: this is the route's shape.
settings.languageHelp: Dates and numbers follow the language. Units are a separate setting.
settings.hrHelp: Zones and effort are computed from these. Leave max HR empty to use the highest you have recorded ({estimate} bpm).
settings.hrHelpNone: Zones and effort are computed from these.
settings.garminOn: Personal API key set on the server.
settings.garminOff: No Garmin key: set GARMIN_PERSONAL_API_KEY on the server.
settings.garminSoon: Renew it soon: it expires on {date}.
profile.name: Name
profile.streak: {count, plural, =0 {No active week yet} one {# week in a row} other {# weeks in a row}}
profile.gearSoon: Shoes and bikes with their distance and wear arrive with the metrics engine (phase 3).
profile.passkeysHelp: Sign in with your fingerprint, face or screen lock: no password or code.
profile.importSoon: Importing your Strava history and exporting everything arrive in later phases.
profile.sessionsLink: Language, units, heart rate and open sessions are in Settings.
profile.noRecords: No records yet: they appear after runs with GPS.
sync.title: Sync
sync.success: Done: {count, plural, =0 {nothing new} one {# new activity} other {# new activities}}.
sync.pending: {count, plural, one {# activity} other {# activities}} still to import
sync.noFit: {count, plural, one {# activity} other {# activities}} without an original FIT file skipped.
sync.notConfigured: Garmin is not configured on this instance.
sync.auto: Garmin also syncs on its own every 15 minutes.
sync.historyHelp: Loads every activity Garmin has, oldest first. It can take a while: it goes on in the background even if you close this tab, and running it again carries on where it stopped.
offline.notice: You are offline: showing what you have already seen. Syncing and saving wait for the connection.
recover.title: Reset your password
recover.sub: Enter your account's e-mail and we will send you a link.
recover.sent: If that e-mail has an account, a link is on its way. It works for 30 minutes.
reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.sub: Then the code from your authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes: the e-mail alone is not enough.
reset.code: Code from the app or a recovery code
reset.done: Password changed and every session signed out. Sign in with the new one.
reset.noToken: This link is incomplete: ask for a new one.
signIn.error.google: That Google account is not linked to this Zankup. Sign in another way and link it in Profile → Account.
profile.googleLinked: Linked: sign in with it, no code needed.
profile.googleError: Google could not be linked: it may be linked to another account.
profile.googleNeedsOther: Set up another way in first: a passkey, or password with two-step verification.
week.title: This week
week.streak: {count, plural, =0 {No streak yet} one {# week in a row} other {# weeks in a row}}
stats.loadNote: Moving time against the average of the previous 12 weeks ({average}).
stats.noRecords: No new records in the last 30 days.
search.summary: {count, plural, =0 {No activities} one {# activity} other {# activities}} · {distance} · {time} · {ascent}
search.show: {count, plural, =0 {No results} one {Show # result} other {Show # results}}
search.name: Activity
strength.summary: {sets, plural, one {# set} other {# sets}} · {reps, plural, one {# rep} other {# reps}} · {volume} kg lifted
strength.noMuscles: The watch did not record which exercises these were, so no muscles are marked.
error.title: Something went wrong
error.body: This screen hit an unexpected error. Reloading usually fixes it.
stats.fitnessNote: Fitness is your 42-day average effort, fatigue your 7-day one, and form the difference: positive means rested.
stats.vsLastYear: {sign}{percent} % vs the same period last year
stats.noPrevious: Nothing in the same period last year
stats.estimatesEmpty: Estimates appear once you have efforts long enough: 20 minutes of power, or runs of 3 km or more.
stats.progressNote: Cumulative distance through each year; the selected year stands out.
event.ramp: Your fitness rose {ramp} points this week: watch the load
stats.efficiencyNote: Speed per heartbeat on your runs: higher means faster at the same HR.
calendar.title: Training calendar
heatmap.title: Your heatmap
heatmap.note: Every route you have recorded with GPS.
routes.title: Your routes
routes.empty: Routes appear here once you repeat one.
segments.title: Your segments
segments.empty: Save a stretch of an activity as a segment: pick it on the profile and press "Save as segment".
segments.name: Segment name
segments.saved: Segment saved: it is being looked for in your other activities.
activity.routeRank: Route done {count} times: this is your #{rank}
goals.title: Goals
goals.onTrack: On track: about {projection} by the end
settings.recomputeNote: Changing these recomputes your whole history in the background.
method.ftp_critical_power: critical power from your best 3 and 12 min
method.lthr_60min: average HR of your best 60 min run
method.lthr_20min: 95% of the average HR of your best 20 min run
method.critical_speed: critical speed from your best 3–30 min efforts
method.riegel: Riegel's formula from your best {km} km
method.hr_max_year: highest HR recorded in the last year
activity.editNote: The original file is never changed: these edits are kept apart and survive reprocessing and imports.
activity.name: Name
compare.title: How these metrics compare
compare.help: Strava's own values from your export against Zankup's. Each metric keeps its own documented formula: this only measures how close they are.
compare.chart: {metric}: Zankup against Strava, one point per activity
compare.largest: The activities that differ the most
compare.notEnough: Not enough activities with this value yet.
compare.scaleHelp: Strava's effort as points per minute in each heart-rate zone, fitted to your own {count} activities (R² {r2}). Nothing here comes from anyone else's data.
data.title: Your data
data.importNote: FIT, TCX, GPX, a Garmin export or your whole Strava history
data.gearNote: Shoes and bikes, with their mileage
export.title: Export all your data
export.help: A ZIP with every original file, your photos and everything else as JSON. It stays ready for seven days.
export.preparing: Preparing… you can leave this page.
gear.title: Gear
gear.help: Shoes and bikes. New activities of a sport get its default gear; mileage counts every activity plus what it had before.
gear.empty: No gear yet. Importing a Strava export brings yours.
gear.deleteConfirm: Delete this gear? Its activities stay, without gear.
gear.overLimit: Past its limit: time to think about replacing it.
import.title: Import
import.help: Bring your history into Zankup. Activities already here are recognised and not duplicated.
import.strava: Strava: the ZIP from Settings → My account → Download or delete your account. Names, descriptions, gear, photos and weather come too; when Garmin already has an activity, Garmin's file wins.
import.garmin: Garmin Connect: the ZIP of your data export.
import.files: Loose FIT, TCX or GPX files, compressed or not.
import.uploadError: The upload failed. Check the connection and try again.
import.problems: {count, plural, one {# file could not be read} other {# files could not be read}}
notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.help: Notifications on this device, in your language. Each browser you use turns them on separately.
notifications.unsupported: This browser cannot receive notifications. On iPhone, add Zankup to the home screen first.
notifications.denied: Notifications are blocked for Zankup in this browser's settings.
notifications.kind.estimate: Estimates going up (FTP, critical speed, VDOT)
photos.title: Photos
photos.error: A photo could not be added.
privacy.title: Privacy zones
privacy.help: Places such as home or work that nothing you share shows: routes are cut where they enter a zone. Your own screens are not affected.
privacy.name: Name
privacy.tap: Tap the map to place a zone.
replay.title: Replay
share.title: Share
share.privacy: Anyone with the link sees this activity without signing in. Your privacy zones are removed from the route; heart rate series, the file and the time of day are never shown.
shared.gone: This link has expired or does not exist.
shared.privacy: Parts of the route near private places are hidden.
mobile.instanceHelp: The address of your Zankup: api.zankup.com, your own domain or your Railway address.
mobile.instanceInvalid: No Zankup answered at that address.
mobile.googleFailed: Google sign-in could not start on this phone.
mobile.googleRejected: This Google account is not linked to this Zankup. Link it in the web app: Profile → Account.
mobile.fingerprintNote: After this, your fingerprint is enough to open Zankup.
mobile.locked: Zankup is locked. Use your fingerprint to open it.
mobile.vsLastYear: Distance {change} vs. the same days last year
mobile.restartForLanguage: The new language applies the next time you open the app.
mobile.pushHelp: New activities, records and Garmin problems on this phone. Which ones you get is set in the web app's Settings.
mobile.push.on: Notifications are on for this phone.
mobile.push.off: Notifications are off for this phone.
mobile.push.denied: Notifications are blocked for Zankup in Android's settings.
mobile.push.unavailable: This build of the app cannot receive notifications.
mobile.biometricsStrong: Your session is stored in Android's keystore and released only by your fingerprint. If your fingerprints change, you will sign in again.
mobile.biometricsWeak: This phone's biometrics are not strong enough to protect the session key (face unlock on many phones). Register a fingerprint, or use them only as an app lock.
mobile.biometricsNone: No fingerprint is enrolled: the session is protected only by the phone's own lock.
mobile.weakLock: Use face unlock as an app lock
health.noReadiness: Readiness needs a week of HRV or resting HR, plus last night's sleep or your form.
health.none: No health data yet. Connect Google Health, use a Garmin that records sleep, or read Health Connect from the Android app.
health.readinessNote: Readiness weighs last night's HRV and resting HR against your last 60 days, the sleep score and your training form (TSB).
health.sourcesLink: Sources and which one to prefer
health.google.connected: Google Health is connected: the first sync is on its way.
health.google.error: Google Health could not be connected. Try again.
health.google.off: Not set up on this server (GOOGLE_HEALTH_ENABLED and a Google OAuth client).
health.google.reconnect: Google stopped sharing the data: connect it again.
health.google.missing: Some permissions were not granted, so part of the data is missing.
health.hc.note: Read from the Android app (You → Settings → Health Connect).
health.counts: {nights, plural, one {# night} other {# nights}}, {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
health.deleteConfirm: Delete every sleep and daily figure from {source}? It cannot be undone.
health.priorityNote: When several sources recorded the same thing, Zankup picks one automatically: for sleep the one with stages, for HRV the source of that night's sleep, for resting HR and steps the one worn longest. You can choose instead.
mobile.hc.title: Health Connect
mobile.hc.note: Reads sleep, resting heart rate, HRV, SpO₂, respiration and steps from Health Connect and sends them to your Zankup. Nothing is written to Health Connect.
mobile.hc.unavailable: Health Connect is not available on this phone.
mobile.hc.done: Sent {nights, plural, one {# night} other {# nights}} and {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}.
health.google.note: Sleep with stages, HRV, SpO₂ and more from a Fitbit Air or another Google device.
ai.title: AI assistant
ai.help: Zankup can summarise each activity, write a report on Mondays and answer your questions as a Coach, with a small language model ({model}). It only ever sees aggregated numbers.
ai.off: Not set up on this server (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY).
ai.budgetWarning: Close to this month's budget: AI features pause when it is reached.
ai.budgetExceeded: This month's AI budget is spent: summaries, reports and the Coach pause until next month.
summary.title: Summary
summary.failed: The summary could not be written. Try again.
coach.title: Coach
coach.intro: Ask about your training. The Coach reads your activities, fitness, records and sleep and answers with your numbers.
coach.suggestion.1: How am I doing for a 10K?
coach.suggestion.2: How was last week compared with the one before?
coach.suggestion.4: Have I set any records lately?
coach.error: The Coach could not answer. Try again.
coach.budget: This month's AI budget is spent: the Coach is back next month.
coach.disclaimer: The Coach can be wrong. It only works from your numbers and is not a doctor.
coach.off: The assistant is off. Turn it on in Settings.
coach.unavailable: Not set up on this server (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY).
weekly.title: Weekly report
weekly.failed: The report could not be written.
weekly.none: The first report arrives next Monday.
mcp.title: Connect an AI assistant (MCP)
mcp.help: Claude or any other assistant that speaks MCP can ask Zankup about your training, read-only and with the same limits as the Coach: aggregated numbers, never your location. Create a token and give it to the assistant as a bearer token for the server URL.
mcp.name: Token name
mcp.created: Copy it now: it is shown only once.
mcp.revokeConfirm: Revoke this token? The assistant using it loses access.
